gate_notes: State-category split not capturable: LPS government delivery is open to all pregnant women without BPL certification, while HPS requires Below Poverty Line (BPL) household and Scheduled Caste (SC)/Scheduled Tribe (ST) status.
Accredited private institutions in LPS & HPS require BPL household plus SC/ST status with proper Below Poverty Line or Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe certificate plus referral slip and JSY card.
Home delivery in all States/UTs requires BPL household with BPL certificate; institutional delivery must be in government health centre or accredited private health institution.
